wind_farms_hourly.notes: yield screen 2026-09-21: 21.95% of val/test windows have a CONSTANT future (mad_const == 0), the highest in the roster; those windows score ~0 at every depth and compress the layer-to-layer differences.

coastal_ts.notes: 24 clusters (2 variates per station) -> 48 val/test windows; the weakest statistical support in the roster.

boom_hourly.notes: yield screen: median constant-forecast MAD 0.121, ~3x lower than any other dataset -> least dynamic range; small absolute deltas mean less here.

electricity_15min.notes: FREQUENCY CONTROL, not domain diversity: the same 370 meters as monash_electricity_hourly at 4x the sampling rate. It holds domain and series fixed and varies only the rate. Never count it toward domain coverage.

monash_london_smart_meters.notes: 5555 eligible series -> deterministic cap. Sparse isolated NaNs poison the unused canonical denominator for 98.5% of series; the REPORTED in-context denominator is unaffected (the context is finite by construction).

m5.notes: 28491 eligible series -> deterministic cap. The yield screen's degeneracy trigger did NOT fire (median constant-forecast MAD 0.490), so rossmann_1D stays a benched alternate.

wiki_daily_100k.notes: 100000 eligible series -> deterministic cap; the largest raw load in the roster (~2.2 GB of float64 series).

mase_definition: MASE is normalized by the seasonal-naive error computed over the 512-step context window using the dataset-specific seasonal period.
